source.author: Falco Schneider
source.kind: private Next.js (Pages Router) + Supabase + ntfy document-link tracker, German README, no licence file

intermediate: A single-tenant Node + SQLite port of the same design, run in production for one deck since 2026-10 (not public). Its server was the reference for app/server.mjs.

port.shape: one zero-dependency Node 22.13+ server, an in-deck tracking script, a dashboard page, a CLI, two references
kept_from_original: shell-only page: the server GET carries no document content, so unfurls are previews
three states preview / opened / read, read = real input + >= 10 active seconds
active-time rule: visible tab + window focus + recent input
one view per tab session, reload bumps opens, heartbeats only raise values
owner exclusion via the unlocked dashboard, timing-safe header password with brute-force brake
bot / unfurler user-agent list, ntfy open + visit-ended summary pushes
changed: Supabase + Vercel replaced by node:sqlite and one process; the original stack is documented in references/supabase-vercel.md, its code is not bundled
scroll depth replaced by per-slide active seconds and visits (Reveal.js events or most-visible slide element)
Supabase Storage signed URL replaced by an HMAC-signed deck URL plus a cookie scoped to the deck version
several named decks, versioned publishing with an atomic current pointer, PDF to HTML via pdftoppm
CLI for doctor/init/start/stop/publish/mint/revoke/report, report in plain words for agents
push and dashboard say 'opened on a second device', never 'forwarded'; push titles name the deck by its published title
genericisations: all product, company, domain, host and person names removed
document registry, link prefixes and bucket paths became config or CLI arguments
no passwords, keys, topics or recipient data shipped; init generates the admin password and the signing key locally

verification: PROOF.md in the lane folder: scripted end-to-end run (13/13 checks) and a cold claude -p run following only SKILL.md (11/11 checks plus a read-back without 'forwarded'), both on localhost, 2026-10-06. No comparative evaluation has been run and no quality claim is made. 2026-10-06 push fix (deck title in push titles, 'Opened on a second device'): scripted run 13/13 again, plus run_push_check.sh 8/8 against a local ntfy stub.
hash_scope: copy_files lists every file this bundle ships except DERIVATION.json. copy_files_sha256 is the sha256 of 'path:sha256' lines in path order, one per line, each terminated by a newline.
